tex_content.html:
Lemma
[the metric at $p$ is positive definite]

1. ch3:4.1For $v\neq 0$, $|v|_p^2=\langle v,v\rangle _p>0$. Hence the center Hessian $\frac{\partial ^2 F}{\partial t^2}(0,p,v)=2|v|_p^2$ (section 3) is strictly positive, giving the strict minimum of $F$ at $q=p$.
Proof

\sketch

Positive-definiteness of the Riemannian metric $g$ at $p$, read in the chart at $p$.

□
